title: Syntony Sidepanel Hopper: Workspace Switch + Contextual Cost Lenses
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Redesign the left navigation to support fast workspace switching and contextual cost/dashboards without losing discoverability. Deliver a mid-fidelity prototype (desktop) that demonstrates: 1) a collapsible 'Syntony' sidepanel that surfaces role-aware workspaces and recently active routes; 2) contextual cost lenses that slide in from the right when an entity (route/model/route-version) is focused; 3) a lightweight workspace 'hopper' flow for switching with preserved filter state; 4) keyboard-first switcher and command-palette integration. Scope excludes backend wiring for persistent preferences (ENG to own).
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates collapsing and expanded sidepanel states with preserved quick-switch history
Cost lens shows token-level breakdown, route attribution, and a primary action to 'Open Cost Dashboard'
Workspace hopper preserves per-workspace dashboard filters when switching between workspaces
Keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+K) opens hopper and navigates to selected route within 2 interactions
Edge cases: workspace switch while a rollout canary is active must surface a confirmation CTA
comments: 2026-02-26 Kickoff: PM (Aisha) requested the hopper to retain alert badges and last-read positions when switching; Eng (Liam) flagged that filter-state persistence requires a small API change
2026-03-01 First prototype review: Design critique — prioritize clear affordances for the cost lens primary action; Accessibility note: ensure 3:1 contrast on compact chip labels
2026-03-03 UX Research: 6/8 participants used keyboard switcher first; confusion around whether filters are global or per-workspace — added 'sticky' label in UI to indicate per-workspace filters
2026-03-05 Eng sync: Miguel proposed a simplified telemetry event for 'hopper_open' and 'workspace_switch' to track friction. Eng asked to scope down animation complexity for first iteration
2026-03-08 PM review: Reduce sidepanel icon density in collapsed state to avoid mis-clicks; added fallback to full rail on small laptop screens
2026-03-10 Design decision: Ship as an opt-in feature flag behind console-ia-syntony. Backend dependency ENG-32144 will implement filter-state API.
decisions: Deliver as feature-flagged opt-in to allow staged rollout
Keep cost lens read-heavy by default and require explicit CTA for exporting or drilling into billing console
Prioritize keyboard-first hopper and simplified animation for M1 launch
Role-aware workspace ordering will be client-side (no server migration) for Q1 launch
tradeoffs: Collapsed rail reduces surface area for new users — mitigated by persistent search and command palette
Per-workspace filter persistence increases backend complexity (requires ENG-32144) but yields less context loss for power users
Cost lens as slide-in keeps dashboards lightweight but prevents side-by-side analytics until user navigates to full dashboard
usability_findings: Keyboard-first users completed common tasks 28% faster with hopper enabled
New users misinterpreted collapsed icons as disabled — added tooltip delay and hover reveal
Participants wanted an explicit 'return to previous workspace' affordance after switching — added breadcrumb micro-undo in prototype
next_steps: Finalize high-fidelity screens for dev handoff by 2026-03-16
Create design tokens and spacing spec for collapsed/expanded states
Pair with ENG on API contract (ENG-32144) and telemetry schema
Schedule feature-flagged canary with 5 internal teams and collect telemetry (2 weeks)
